text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Narita Brian! Holding off 
the ‘Master Thespian’ and the ‘Double 
Crown Umamusume,’ the one who captures the 
finish line is Narita Brian!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even those two were no match for 
you. I wonder who will be the one to 
defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Is it just me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the fever still hasn't gone down. 
There's not even a sign of it cooling off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, there are still more of them, 
right? Umamusume like those girls."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become even stronger. What race 
should I enter to—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ! McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It was a splendid showing, today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run ahead of me, it felt as 
though I was being forced to confront my 
own shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we get back on topic?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is the first leg of 
the Autumn Senior Triple Crown. Boasting a 
long history, this autumn stage continues 
to shine as the ultimate honor for those 
who contest in speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If it is strength you seek, you ought to 
run in it. Narita Brian."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...You're there, right, Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you were that curious, instead of just 
watching, you should have called out to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, she must have been just that 
frustrated by her defeat. I understand 
that feeling all too well myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yet I shall not give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as she is in the Twinkle Series. 
As long as I challenge the Twinkle Series. 
We can race as many times as we want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's why next time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. That is fine as it is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn), huh.
choice_data_list: Shall we get the preparations underway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Please. Retrain me from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Make these fangs even sharper. Strong 
enough to tear through the throats of the 
mighty—!
